mechanism: Isoniazid may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of sitagliptin, potentially increasing sitagliptin levels, while isoniazid itself carries hepatotoxicity risk that may be compounded in diabetic patients on glucose-lowering agents.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely, watch for signs of hepatotoxicity, and consider dose adjustment of sitagliptin if renal function declines or hepatic impairment develops during isoniazid therapy.
